mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medicine_stock_alert (user_medicine_id, alert_type, alert_level, message, days_remaining, is_read, is_resolved, create_time) VALUES (#{userMedicineId}, #{alertType}, #{alertLevel}, #{message}, #{daysRemaining}, 0, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE medicine_stock_alert SET alert_level = #{alertLevel}, message = #{message}, days_remaining = #{daysRemaining}, is_read = #{isRead}, is_resolved = #{isResolved} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE medicine_stock_alert SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE medicine_stock_alert SET is_resolved = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, COALESCE(um.custom_name, mi.name) as medicine_name FROM medicine_stock_alert a LEFT JOIN user_medicines um ON a.user_medicine_id = um.id LEFT JOIN medicine_info mi ON um.medicine_id = mi.id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId} AND a.is_read = 0 AND a.is_resolved = 0 ORDER BY a.alert_level DESC, a.create_time DESC

SELECT a.*, COALESCE(um.custom_name, mi.name) as medicine_name FROM medicine_stock_alert a LEFT JOIN user_medicines um ON a.user_medicine_id = um.id LEFT JOIN medicine_info mi ON um.medicine_id = mi.id WHERE a.user_medicine_id = #{userMedicineId} ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
